name: 55315 · Carver, MN
findings: ZIP 55315 (Carver) has 11 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55315 (Carver) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
